svg.title: Timing Diagram
svg.desc: This timing diagram shows the visible-tab state and refresh/request states across the configured 30-second polling ticks. The initial refresh and subsequent successful requests update the inventory data and timestamp.
svg.text: UML timing | visible inventory refresh; configured default interval = 30 seconds
Scenario: refresh finishes before the next scheduled tick; the tab remains visible.
Elapsed response durations are illustrative, not measured or guaranteed.
The code permits refreshSeconds from 15 to 120 seconds and uses a 15-second Axios timeout.
success → data and updated timestamp set
next success → data and timestamp replaced
